pr_title: Bluetooth: TBS: Add support for dynamic TBS
pr_body:
The TBS and GTBS instances can now be dynamically registered
and unregistered, which fits better for the use cases of TBS
where specific bearers can come and go depending on the
features of the device.
    
For example if a SIM card is inserted, then a device can
register a TBS for the provider and remove it again if the
SIM card is removed.

fixes https://github.com/zephyrproject-rtos/zephyr/issues/41738

issue_context.title: LE Audio: Dynamically register TBS
issue_context.body:
**Is your enhancement proposal related to a problem? Please describe.**
The TBS instances are currently statically defined, and their initial values are set by Kconfigs. This is a ineffective way of handling a service that may be registered multiple times, as well as a the fact that TBS services can come and go. 

**Describe the solution you'd like**
Use the `bt_gatt_service_register` to dynamically register TBS instances, which would also allow the register to set initial values per service. Follow the API used by e.g. CSIS or VOCS. 

**Describe alternatives you've considered**
A clear and concise description of any alternative solutions or features you've considered.

**Additional context**
Add any other context or graphics (drag-and-drop an image) about the feature request here.
